executed_controls.method: Original helper modules type-stripped, one local import suffix rewritten; synthetic async conditions and URL strings only.

findings: waitUntilAbortable checks stop before condition and after sleep, but not after awaited condition. Condition setting stoptrue then returningready is accepted. Preexisting stop correctly throwsStopRequested.

remaining timeout decreases by configuredpollDelay rather than elapsed condition time; helper does not impose strict wallclock deadline on asynchronous condition. Source finding, not measured timeout experiment.
Exact URL helper rejectshttp,lookalikehost,credentials,nondefaultport; account2albumabc%20def parsed correctly. This does not establish caller revalidation after navigation.
isRunOccupied is pure truthy flag aggregation, not atomic lock. Caller handshake/ownership remains to review.
Unified status sets separate active,paused,terminal states. Config documents empirical500batch ceiling; not independently validated.
Public core index reexports browser-specific modules as well as pure helpers. Importing pure named exports is not evidence all exported functions are environment independent.
